_source: Zambian OBC 2013 Religious Education (2044) — distinct syllabus edition from the 2046 edition already bundled (subject code 'RE'); given its own code 'RE2044' and its own subject name so the two never collide in the Subject & Grade picker. Built 2026-08-31 from a real Google Drive document, 'GRADE 11 2044 RELIGIOUS EDUCATION SCHEME OF WORK TERM 3.docx' (a real Term 3 scheme of work) — the same real document used to reconnect this app's pre-existing 30 real RE 2044 embedded lesson plans (assets/lesson_plans/religious_education_grade10-11.json), which had been entirely inert since being built because no RE 2044 syllabus existed for them to match against. Real PII stripped: the source document's header carried a real teacher's name and a real named boarding secondary school in every row — both removed, appear nowhere in this file. Term 1 'Life' is a direct, exact match to the embedded lesson plans' own topic_name field (matching is topic-name-only, no sub-topic granularity in that file, so no sub-topics are invented here either). Term 1 placement is an inference, not directly stated: the source Term 3 document explicitly reviews 'Courtship and Marriage'/'Family Life' as '(Review of) Term 2' content, and previews Grade 12 content in the remaining weeks — introducing no new Grade 11 content of its own — so 'Life', the only other real Grade 11 topic on record, is placed in Term 1 by elimination, not directly confirmed by a Term 1 document. Term 2's two sub-topics and their references ('Syllabus pg 27-30' / 'pg 30-32') are copied verbatim from the source's real 'Review of Term 2' row content. Real content from this same source document that belongs to Grade 12's own curriculum (a detailed 'Grade 12 Preview' covering real topic 12.1/12.2 sub-topics) was extracted into religious_education_2044_grade12.json instead, not duplicated here, since it's Grade 12's own content being previewed early, not Grade 11's. Term 3 (revision-of-Term-2 + Grade 12 preview + tests) is deliberately not represented as its own term entry here: it introduces no new Grade 11 content beyond what Term 2 already covers, and the Grade 12 preview content lives in the Grade 12 file instead — omitted transparently, not silently. No Grade 10 RE 2044 term/week source document exists yet; that syllabus (already bundled, matching the lesson plans' 'Living in a Changing Society'/'Order and Freedom in Society' topics) remains untouched, still without real term/week data.
